A '''Rattataki sash''' was band of cloth worn about the waist as part of a traditional [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] outfit.

It was seemingly decorated with bright shades of orange and abstract symbols&mdash;or sometimes in gray with cross-like motives&mdash;and maintained by a [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] sun disc.
[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was known to wear one of those.
